payload.title: Use application authentication in evaluation and resource CLI clients
payload.description:
## Problem

After a successful application login, several local CLI command modules still construct the dashboard client through the legacy API-key-only constructor. Identity commands succeed, but resource discovery and evaluation setup fail before making GraphQL requests when no API key is present.

## Expected behavior

Given a user has an active Cognito application session
And no AWS or API-key credentials are available
When the user invokes scorecard discovery or starts an evaluation
Then the command uses the centralized explicit-auth client factory
And GraphQL requests use Cognito authorization
And no API-key, IAM, AWS-profile, or direct-storage fallback occurs.

## Acceptance

- Behavior-first tests reproduce the stale constructor path.
- Evaluation and resource CLI entrypoints delegate to the centralized client factory.
- Existing command-level test doubles remain supported without runtime monkeypatching of Tactus.
- Cognito sandbox discovery and representative evaluation setup succeed without AWS or API-key credentials.
